reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified restriction to the north region (N=684). In the full sample with the same or fuller controls, training_hours has a significant positive effect (about 0.80–0.84, p<0.001). The effect is also much larger in the south (about 1.86, p<0.001), so the north-only null is a subgroup artifact and the report doesn't disclose this.
